mission: To generate qualified pipeline through a scientific, always-on experiment cadence by owning campaign execution, Webflow, marketing attribution, lead routing, and channel performance, while continuously testing new ways to create demand for GPC.
capacity: All time logged in ClickUp daily. Core operating metrics updated ahead of every relevant review. Flag Grant in advance if a week is trending past your contracted hours.

kpis.name: 1. Marketing-Sourced Qualified Pipeline
kpis.calculation: Dollar value of qualified sales opportunities sourced by marketing

kpis.name: 2. Paid Media ROAS
kpis.calculation: Collected marketing-sourced revenue ÷ paid media spend

kpis.name: 3. MQL to Qualified Opportunity Rate
kpis.calculation: Marketing-generated leads accepted as qualified sales opportunities ÷ total MQLs

kpis.name: 5. Experiment Execution Rate
kpis.calculation: Required experiments completed with hypothesis, metric, budget, scale/stop decision, and postmortem

outcomes.howMeasured: 1 monthly experiment and 1 quarterly big bet active at all times; each has a documented hypothesis, target metric, budget, and kill/scale rule; postmortem completed ≤72h after the experiment ends
≥60 ICP MQLs/month when ramped; ≥30% MQL to qualified opportunity; marketing-sourced qualified pipeline ≥$750K/quarter when ramped
Accountable for publishing, copy, and design direction; pages ship ≤5 business days from an approved brief and hit ≥3.5% conversion or the agreed page-specific target

100% of marketing-generated leads enter HubSpot with source, campaign, and UTM data; attribution coverage ≥95%; ≥98% of qualified leads routed to the Setter; routing failures corrected within 1 business day

Stay within approved budget ±10%; budget increases deployed only when prior-quarter performance supports scaling; underperforming campaigns stopped or materially changed within 7 days of falling below threshold

Submit ≥1 qualified automation or GTM engineering brief per month when a technical build could materially improve acquisition, conversion, personalization, or marketing ops, including problem, proposed outcome, and success metric
Test ≥1 new acquisition channel or tactic per quarter with a documented hypothesis, target metric, result, and scale/stop decision
Maintain paid-media ROAS of ≥6x Q1, ≥5x Q2, ≥4x Q3, ≥4x Q4, measured on collected marketing-sourced revenue

competencies.body: Paid ad experience: design, media buying, and performance analysis.

values.label: Build-Sharpen-Scale.
values.body: Turns winning pages, campaigns, audiences, and experiments into reusable systems, and kills low-performing tactics quickly.

values.label: Passion for Modern Solutions.
values.body: Stays current on AI, automation, data providers, personalization, and modern GTM tooling, and uses them when they improve measurable performance.

values.label: Empathetic Ownership.
values.body: Owns qualified pipeline and marketing spend outcomes, not activity volume. Spends company money like it's their own.

values.label: Be Decent, Be Direct.
values.body: Reports results clearly, communicates what is and isn't working, and makes direct recommendations on what to scale, improve, or stop.
